violations.why: Timer_Force_isr (priority 3) can preempt Timer_A_isr between the read and write of timerCount++, so its write is lost.
Timer_Force_isr can preempt Timer_A_isr after the increment and set timerCount to 0. The check at line 96 then reads 0, not the value just written.
Timer_Force_isr can preempt Timer_A_isr between its reads and change timerCount, so the two reads see different values.
Timer_Force_isr can preempt Timer_B_isr after it writes 1 and set timerCount to 0. The check at line 109 then fails.
